needed.suggestion: Install a proper sidewalk on the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Remove parked vehicles obstructing the informal path on the left side.
Repair uneven sections of the informal path on the left side to prevent trip hazards.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing if there is demand for crossing.
Enhance visibility of any potential crossing points if needed.
Install a refuge island if there are multiple lanes and pedestrian crossings.
Add dropped kerbs at crossings to indicate pedestrian areas.
Increase street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.
